notes.title: Update on My House is Haunted
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is Pogu. Today, I would like to share to you guys about My House is Haunted is going to be first person shooter. There will be going to be a leveling system. Most of the time, hordes of zombie or ghost will come to you and you as a player will shoot them. Pretty basic gameplay with additional upgrades on gun skills and whatnot similar to Vampire Survivor. Last week, I made a progress to create the character controller for first person shooter. It looks good to me. Next I will tackle how to approach the hordes of enemies.

That's about it, peace!

notes.title: FAQ about My House is Haunted
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

My name is Pogu Desu, sole creator of My House is Haunted. I created this game within 78 Days. Most of the work development I made, I did it live on Youtube link.

FAQ About Me:

1. How many people involve in this development.
 
Just one and that's me. However, I asked some artist to help me with my art. 


2. How long you been creating games
 
 This is my first commercial game. I started polishing my skill one year ago. I just watched youtube game dev to learn every single day.


3. Your first commercial game is incomplete. Are you sure will you deliver your promises to the customer by 2023 Q2?
 
 I will do my best to finish the game by 2023 Q2. I made the game within 78 days, this proof that I have the ability to finish the game. You can watch my progress live on youtube ːmhwgoodː


4. What are the complete game looks like?

 3 Additional Maps
 15 usable items in total
 Atleast 1 additional ghost
 More selections of character model for exorcist
 Atleast 1 additional class for exorcist
 Different mechanics for each map
 Economic system where you can buy items
 Ghost ability progression
 Leveling System


If you have any question please send me message on either twitter or discord.
